versions.changelog:
- Updated guidance to clarify that MTV Rewind focuses on 80s–2010s music videos, not just current chart hits.
- Adjusted “When NOT to Use” section to mention limited coverage for brand-new releases and strongest support for retro content.

- Added installation instructions for ClawHub CLI, including global and local install commands.
- Clarified that no API keys, binaries, or configuration are required.
- Provided a security note regarding future updates and credentials.
- No changes to core functionality or responses.
Initial release — 90,000+ classic MTV music videos, 80s/90s/2000s, with native Telegram Web App support
